rationale.rules-based-checks: Parser-backed deterministic checks inspect fail-soft patterns in AI-attributed code.
rationale.quality-debt: Matched studies find excess high-severity non-security reliability failures in AI code.
rationale.ai-review: Controlled comparisons expose severe under-detection by an LLM code evaluator.
rationale.risk-routing: UNKNOWN outcomes and human-only checks explicitly trigger manual verification.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Findings provide reviewers file, line, severity, and issue descriptions.
rationale.framework: Reusable 15-check inspection architecture integrates CLI, web, and research pipelines.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and released CLI, web scanner, and deterministic engine.
rationale.agentic: Core public studies analyze agent-attributed code delivered through pull requests.
rationale.metrics: Defines and operationalizes quality through failure-truthfulness checks and severity findings.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirically measures fail-soft reliability degradation and evaluates its mitigation.
rationale.method-mining: Scans enterprise and public repository artifacts to characterize observed code patterns.
rationale.method-field-study: Audits six active enterprise AI-assisted systems in their operational environment.
rationale.method-experiment: Compares a third-party LLM evaluator against static checks on identical files.
